question: What is the median year of publication?

question: Of the top ten most prolific authors, who were the top ten pairs who published with each other the most, and how many papers did they co-publish?
sql: WITH top_authors AS (SELECT Author FROM paper_authorships GROUP BY Author ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT Title) DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT p1.Author, p2.Author, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.Title) as copaper_count FROM paper_authorships p1 JOIN paper_authorships p2 ON p1.Title = p2.Title WHERE p1.Author IN (SELECT Author FROM top_authors) AND p2.Author IN (SELECT Author FROM top_authors) AND p1.Author < p2.Author GROUP BY p1.Author, p2.Author ORDER BY copaper_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which institutions have had researchers publish at all three conferences in the same year?
sql: SELECT Affiliation, Year FROM paper_authorships GROUP BY Affiliation, Year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Conference) = 3

question: Find the author pairs who have collaborated the most across different conferences
sql: SELECT p1.Author, p2.Author, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.Conference) as conference_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p1.Title) as paper_count FROM paper_authorships p1 JOIN paper_authorships p2 ON p1.Title = p2.Title AND p1.Conference = p2.Conference WHERE p1.Author < p2.Author GROUP BY p1.Author, p2.Author HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p1.Conference) > 1 ORDER BY conference_count DESC, paper_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the year-over-year growth rate of papers at each conference?
sql: SELECT p1.Conference, p1.Year, p1.paper_count, p2.paper_count as prev_year_count, CAST((p1.paper_count - p2.paper_count) AS FLOAT) * 100 / p2.paper_count as growth_rate FROM (SELECT Conference, Year, COUNT(DISTINCT Title) as paper_count FROM paper_authorships GROUP BY Conference, Year) p1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT Conference, Year, COUNT(DISTINCT Title) as paper_count FROM paper_authorships GROUP BY Conference, Year) p2 ON p1.Conference = p2.Conference AND p1.Year = p2.Year + 1 WHERE p2.paper_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p1.Conference, p1.Year

question: Which authors from Stanford have co-authored with authors from MIT, and on which papers?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p1.Author as Stanford_Author, p2.Author as MIT_Author, p1.Title FROM paper_authorships p1 JOIN paper_authorships p2 ON p1.Title = p2.Title WHERE p1.Affiliation LIKE '%Stanford%' AND p2.Affiliation LIKE '%MIT%' AND p1.Author != p2.Author

question: Find the top 5 most collaborative affiliations based on average co-authors per paper
sql: SELECT p1.Affiliation, AVG(author_count) as avg_coauthors FROM paper_authorships p1 JOIN (SELECT Title, COUNT(DISTINCT Author) as author_count FROM paper_authorships GROUP BY Title) p2 ON p1.Title = p2.Title GROUP BY p1.Affiliation ORDER BY avg_coauthors DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which years saw the highest increase in paper submissions compared to the previous year?
sql: SELECT p1.Year, p1.paper_count - p2.paper_count as increase FROM (SELECT Year, COUNT(DISTINCT Title) as paper_count FROM paper_authorships GROUP BY Year) p1 JOIN (SELECT Year, COUNT(DISTINCT Title) as paper_count FROM paper_authorships GROUP BY Year) p2 ON p1.Year = p2.Year + 1 ORDER BY increase DESC LIMIT 5
